subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser-tool field-report items should become first-class browser API behavior now, rather than staying as skill/docs guidance or narrower follow-up issues?
rationale: The unresolved items span automatic post-action state refresh, stale-ref signaling, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker detection, CDP element inspection, and fill verification; those change model-facing browser behavior and need owner intent before a repair lane chooses a contract.

options.title: Prioritize stale-state signals
options.body: Keep this issue open and split the remaining work into targeted API/design issues for stale-ref/action-result signals, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker detection, and CDP inspection, with one owner-approved contract per PR.

options.title: Limit to guidance
options.body: Document the current skill-driven recovery loop and close or defer API additions until a stronger live repro shows automation cannot recover with existing selector, batch, wait, ARIA-ref, and skill guidance.

options.title: Sponsor broad browser API expansion
options.body: Accept this report as a broader browser-tool roadmap item and assign an owner to design the full model-facing API surface before implementation.

recommendation.title: Prioritize stale-state signals
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and split the remaining work into targeted API/design issues for stale-ref/action-result signals, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker detection, and CDP inspection, with one owner-approved contract per PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged selector/batch work that already resolved the highest-priority pieces and are the clearest history-linked owner for the browser action contract.
